evidence_scope: K2 A/B/C/D selection only; these timings are not formal K2 candidate results
host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

target_population.selection: all 14 decode census rows and all 343 exact C02 module weights, aggregated by semantic variant
target_population.module_order_policy: model.named_modules registration order, used as a full 343-call streaming sequence to prevent repeated-single-weight L2 cache bias
target_population.representative_module_policy: lexicographically first exact C02 module for layout metadata only

baseline_probe.eager: bitsandbytes 0.50.0 fused bitsandbytes::gemm_4bit CUDA dispatch using the exact C02 packed weight and nested scale tensors
baseline_probe.compile: torch.compile(fullgraph=true, mode=reduce-overhead, dynamic=false) around the exact same tensor-only bitsandbytes::gemm_4bit call
baseline_probe.correctness_check: compiled output must be exactly equal to eager output for every representative module
baseline_probe.input: seeded unit-normal BF16 tensor with shape [1,1,K]

analytic_bytes.formula: input BF16 bytes + packed NF4 bytes + uint8 first-level absmax bytes + float32 second-level absmax bytes + 256-entry float32 scale codebook + float32 offset + output BF16 bytes + optional bias bytes
analytic_bytes.cache_guard: Every listed tensor is counted once per invocation; no cache reuse across the 343 model calls is credited.

measurement_protocol.samples_per_variant: 200 multiplied by the variant's real calls_per_forward
measurement_protocol.interleave_order: eager/compile rotation by full-sequence repetition index; module order is identical to the formal carrier

bottleneck_gate.metric: invocation-weighted aggregate compile Tier-A relative roofline score
bottleneck_gate.rationale: K2 has no K1 method-value exception; at least 20% compile-to-ceiling headroom must exist before candidate implementation is authorized.

capability_design_gate.required_layout: row-major [N,K], two NF4 nibbles per uint8 byte, K divisible by 64, nested scale block 256
capability_design_gate.candidate_scope: M=1 BF16 decode only; prefill and any invariant miss fall back to bitsandbytes
capability_design_gate.implementation: Triton 3.7.1 fused nibble decode + nested scale decode + dot/reduction, sm_89 only
capability_design_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not materialize the full BF16 weight matrix

deliverability_design_gate.reconnection: torch.library custom op plus reversible Linear4bit decode dispatch; parameter objects and state_dict keys remain unchanged
deliverability_design_gate.fallback: Call the original Linear4bit forward unless M=1, NF4, nested block64/256, BF16, CUDA sm_89, no-grad, and no bias all hold
